newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Earthquake jolts Indonesia west Sumatra, no damage.
newsitem.headline: Earthquake jolts Indonesia west Sumatra, no damage.

text.p: An earthquake measuring 4.5 on the Richter scale shook Indonesia's west Sumatra province on Wednesday, but there were no reports of damage or casualties, the official Antara news agency reported.

It quoted meteorology officials as saying the earthquake jolted the province early on Wednesday and tremors could be felt in the provincial capital Padang. The epicentre was located 30 km (18.6 miles) southeast of Padang.
